value.summary: The Xbox PDB 'AudioTrack*' function cluster (AudioTrackInit/Kill/Vol/Pan/MusicVol/Set/Update/VolSub/AudioTrack4) is not its own PDB module. It is a positional subset of AUDIO.OBJ (68 functions, per tools/gdl/xbmod.py --module AUDIO), which is the Xbox counterpart of the already-written GC TU game/audio/audio.c (39 real-named functions, NonMatching, active matching/de-fakematch work, no fn_ stubs). There is no separate unwritten 'audio-mixer' TU for this cluster to land in.
